answer: The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the willow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, re-queued for a second panel.
